title: warm spicy tunisian pistachio skillet
description: a spicy, fluffy, and festive tunisian dish featuring pistachio and perfectly cooked vegetables in a cast-iron skillet. great for a weeknight dinner or as a special occasion meal.
instructions: heat the olive oil in a 12-inch cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
add the diced onion and cook until lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes.
add the diced bell pepper and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
add the diced zucchini and cook until lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes.
in a large bowl, whisk together the pistachio flour, all purpose flour, baking powder, salt, ground cumin, ground coriander, and chili flakes.
add the crumbled cottage cheese to the bowl and stir to combine.
pour the wet ingredient mixture over the dry ingredient mixture and stir until just combined.
pour the batter into the prepared skillet and smooth the top.
cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
remove the skillet from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
